messages.subject: Short course: Computational Approaches to Analyzing Microarray Data
messages.subject_clean: Short course: Computational Approaches to Analyzing Microarray Data
messages.body_plain:
Computational Approaches to Analyzing Microarray Data: This intensive computer lab based course includes modules on experimental design, data management, statistics, data mining techniques, diagnostics, arrays as a phenotype, using prior knowledge to constrain analyses and modeling techniques.  It is geared for people in molecular biology lab groups and mathematical or computation scientists entering the field of bioinformatics.  Instructors include researchers, bioinformaticians, statisticians and computer scientists.
Dates: July 24-28, 2013
Fees: $950 for faculty and industry employees; $650 for graduate students and postdoctoral researchers; $350 special rate for UW-Madison students and postdoctoral researchers.

More info: http://www.btci.org/courses/intermediate/caamd/2013/caamd13.html
